aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month. It leans into leverage and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. income.read: This income plan prioritizes parking cash for yield, targeting ~1%/month. It rotates heavily into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index for monthly distributions, cutting high-beta names. While aiming for reliable income and low drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
